description: Move a claim on the scale — open, paper, computer, lean, refuted, retracted — with the ground it moved on in 'reason' (a merge, a computation that finished, a reviewer's word, the issue it was decided in). The journal keeps the line: who, when, from what to what and why; this is the one place a status changes, so the paper and the site that read it agree. Name the claim by 'id', or by 'project' and 'label'. The same status again changes nothing. Members of the project who may write only.

id.description: The claim, as list_claims returned it.

reason.description: On what ground — at most 1000 characters.

status.description: open, paper, computer, lean, refuted or retracted.

name: set_claim_status
